findings.numeric: Independent literal CSR/support/cosine/decimal expectations. Threshold-order fixture: supports [3,2,10,9], retained pair supports [2,8,8], cosine units [365148,843274,843274]. Equal-cosine fixture: 2/sqrt(12) = 4/sqrt(48), 577350 units; support 4 wins over support 2 before slug.
findings.resource_guards: Exact/one-over injected profile, raw-positive, item and pair-contribution caps; np.empty/np.ones forbidden on rejected builds. Distinct-pair and invalid-config rejection forbid csc_matrix.__matmul__. Total retained-neighbor cap rejects before immutable output arrays. Actual 100-neighbor cap tested on 101 and 102 items with dense conversion forbidden; existing 1000 visited-edge limit and new actual 100000 raw-state boundaries pass.
findings.unsupported: Empty, single-user, single-item, duplicate, malformed, nonfinite and out-of-range inputs covered. Existing source/dislike exclusion and absent pair mean reused. Mixed unsupported plus zero-degree query sources do not dilute scores or create edges.
findings.purity_review: Reviewed collaborative.py input/output contracts, canonicalization, bounded immutable row lookup and score path. No user identifier, database session, clock read, training, network, filesystem call or global mutable scoring state in those paths. Loaded artifact is consumed only in memory. Repeated scoring around an empty call forbids builtins.open and Path.open, preserves input context and array bytes. Existing contracts/handoff prove identity-free payload and exact source exclusions. This limited 9C review does not close release-wide M02/9J.
findings.repeatability: Temporary fixture builds from original input, reversed rows/reversed items and repeated original input have equal exact member bytes. Canonical profile fingerprints, loaded manifests, item axis and all five semantic arrays compare equal; no persistent build is selected. Rechecked by focused and full ML commands.
